parser.method: Remove non-nested $( ... $) comments, split remaining bytes on whitespace, then collect tokens between each $v/$c marker and its following $. marker.

formal_system_control.source_requirement: For every variable typecode, the corresponding preimage under the type function is not finite.
formal_system_control.reading: A literal mapping from the finite raw source token pool to the entire mFS variable universe cannot discharge this requirement. A valid actual-database mapping must explicitly provide an infinite variable extension and prove its relation to the finite source representation.
formal_system_control.scope: This is a direct-source mapping control, not a theorem that set theory cannot represent infinity or a proof that no companion construction exists.
